added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no baseline_suite arm and no after_suite arm (both null), so no base/head gate-log pair exists to reduce and the added-failure count was not taken. The reviewed run's only gate, gate-figures.log over draw_pairs.py, is a custom log with EXIT=0 and no failing test id, so there are no added failures to derive; the reviewed run also changed no test file, so there is nothing for a base/head comparison to hold.

findings.text: follow-on: the node ships no test, so nothing fails if the committed figure set regresses — a missing SVG or PNG, a re-introduced role word, or a swapped bad letter would land silently. The only executable guard is draw_pairs.py itself, which nothing runs automatically, and the declared negative control is none, so the artefact set is protected only by the coordinator's own view against pairs.json.

follow-on: the gate log records svg_count, png_count, banned_words_hits and EXIT, but not the done-when's clean-re-run clause; the reproduction the node measured is asserted only in the manifest's prose, so a reader of the log alone cannot see that the file set reproduces. I reproduced it independently (a scratch copy of draw_pairs.py re-run twice left the ten SVGs and pairs.json byte-identical to the committed tree; only pair-2's colour-only pair and the declared PNG tIME chunk differ), so the claim holds — it is the record, not the fact, that is thin.

follow-on: the brief's step 4 asks the worker to say in the manifest whether it viewed each PNG against pairs.json (and to write that it could not, if the harness shows no images); the manifest states neither, so the visual reconciliation is unrecorded. I viewed all ten PNGs and each matches pairs.json — the five bad figures carry exactly their named defect and their twins do not — so the gap is a recording omission, not a defect in the figures.

item_verdicts.write_paths: the dispatch fenced the node to docs/figures/figure-review-pairs, docs/evidence/fragments/a-review-can-see-the-figure/the-five-figure-pairs-are-drawn.html and docs/figures/a-review-can-see-the-figure/the-five-figure-pairs-are-drawn. justifications.evidence: docs/figures/figure-review-pairs/gate-figures.log records svg_count 10, png_count 10, banned_words_hits 0 and EXIT=0 over draw_pairs.py:1, and I reproduced the ten SVGs and pairs.json byte-identically from a scratch copy, but the log carries no reproduction clause so the done-when's file-set claim rests on the manifest's prose alone.
